messages:
Alice: FYI — Equinox Financial just raised a set of blockers on the POC: on‑prem requirement, SOC2 attestation, SAML/SCIM, and a request for an exec intro if we can't meet a 2‑week bridge. Need quick alignment.

Bob: Got it. I need clarification on scope: do they want BYOK/HSM integration or is KMS enough? Also what's the ask for Dedicated vs Private pricing?

Erin: For an initial Dedicated with VPC peering + KMS we can do a beta in ~2 weeks if infra allocation is approved. Full air‑gapped on‑prem package with HSM integration is 6–8 weeks (validation + tests).

Carlos: They sent over a security questionnaire and an NDA. I'm reviewing; main legal flags: EU‑only data residency clause and an indemnity ask that's outside our standard. Also need to confirm acceptable SOC2 artifacts.

Dana: Security note — we can provide our SOC2 Type II and a redacted controls matrix. SAML + SCIM are supported by our Private/Dedicated flows; HSM requires additional engineering effort. If they need HSM in 2 weeks that will need a fast‑track change request.

Alice: They also want pricing options: (A) Hosted with encryption in transit, (B) Dedicated reserved capacity w/ VPC, (C) Private on‑prem. They asked for a bridge option with a shorter commitment. Any guidance?

Frank: High level — we can offer Dedicated with customer KMS + VPC peering as a short‑term bridge (2 weeks to provision), Private on‑prem remains 6–8 weeks. Pricing: Dedicated = monthly reserved + overage; Private = platform license + onboarding + support. Need Sales to lock expected term to size the discount.

Bob: I'll draft a POC runbook: 1) sandbox hosted with restricted tokens & prefix KV caching, 2) Dedicated reserved nodes with VPC peering and bring‑your‑own‑KMS, 3) ramp to private deploy if required. Will include network/IP allowlist and test plan.

Alice: They want an exec intro if we can't commit to the 2‑week bridge. @Frank — can you do a 15m call with their CTO Tue morning?

Frank: I can take Tue 10:00 ET. Will prepare a short deck: architecture, timelines, SLA and high level mitigations.

Carlos: Legal needs the SOW template + our standard liability caps sent to the buyer. If they insist on broader indemnities we need to escalate — won't be able to accept without VP sign‑off.

Dana: Also request the customer's network contact and a data flow diagram. They indicated downstream flows might capture PANs — need to know if tokenization or PCI scope required.

Alice: They said it’s not full PCI onboarding but they do ingest card data in some workflows. I told them we'd propose tokenization + encryption at rest.

Erin: For the POC we can add a preprocessing step to mask PANs and provide a temporary redaction layer. I'll sketch a data flow diagram and minimal safe config.

Bob: I'll bundle the POC plan, network checklist, and initial Dedicated vs Private pricing and send to Equinox by EOD.

Alice: Action items — Bob: POC plan + pricing by EOD; Carlos: finish SOW + legal redlines by tomorrow morning; Dana: push SOC2 artifacts + SAML guide to the thread; Erin: data flow diagram and masking approach; Frank: prep exec talking points and confirm Tue 10am ET. I'll update CRM and mark as 'exec escalation' if we can't get commitments within 48 hours. :thumbsup:

Frank: Noted. If Legal stalls, @Alice escalate to VP Sales for decision on indemnity and pricing flex.

Alice: Thanks all — I'll coordinate the intro and loop in the buyer.

Bob: Sending checklist now (preview link: https://redwood.internal/share/poc-checklist/equinox).

Carlos: Uploaded NDA review notes to the thread. One question outstanding re: data residency — will follow up.

Dana: Uploaded SOC2 redacted PDF and SAML quickstart link.

Erin: Pushed data flow SVG to the shared drive, linking in CRM.

Alice: Closing the loop — will circulate consolidated reply to Equinox after Bob's plan lands. If timeline slips past 2 weeks, I'll request the exec intro immediately.
